title: Domain mail policies
description: Inbound and outbound delivery are configured independently for each domain. Secrets are returned only to administrators with configuration permission.
outboundDescription: Resend API keys and SMTP credentials are stored per domain.

imap.realtimeHelp: MoeMail checks CAPABILITY first. Servers with IDLE notify the read-only listener immediately; servers without it automatically stay on the same complete polling fallback, which also recovers missed notifications and downtime.
imap.advancedHelp: IDLE is renewed before common provider timeouts, and reconnect delay grows exponentially within the selected range. At most 32 read-only listeners run at once; every additional account remains covered by bounded polling.
imap.certificateHelp: Keep this enabled for public email providers.
imap.readOnlyHelp: IDLE and polling access the mailbox read-only: they do not mark messages as read, move them, or delete them. Alias or catch-all forwarding must preserve a header that identifies the original recipient.

mailu.title: Mailu integration
mailu.description: Use the Mailu v1 API to reconcile exact aliases, ingest through one IMAP collector, and send through the same collector without granting wildcard sender spoofing.
mailu.compactDisabled: Disabled; settings and background tasks remain inactive.
mailu.domainHelp: This domain uses the global Mailu collector. Only the configured trusted delivery header is accepted; MIME To/Cc never selects a MoeMail mailbox.
mailu.senderSafety: Mailu sending requires an active MoeMail mailbox and an exact managed Mailu alias to the collector. Catch-all aliases never authorize a From address.

accounts.title: Managed service accounts
accounts.safety: They must be two distinct Mailu users. MoeMail forces allow_spoofing off and disables login for the catch-all account; it only forwards to the collector and cannot authenticate to SMTP.

imap.title: IMAP collection
imap.realtimeHelp: MoeMail checks CAPABILITY and keeps a read-only IDLE listener when available. Mailu then notifies it immediately; the complete periodic scan still covers missed notifications, unsupported servers, and connection outages.
imap.advancedHelp: IDLE renews before common provider cutoffs. Automatic reconnect uses exponential backoff within the selected range; polling remains active independently.

retention.title: Upstream retention
retention.safety: Delete or move is queued only after MoeMail commits the message or proves an existing duplicate. Rejected and unknown-recipient messages remain upstream.

reconcile.title: Mailu reconciliation
reconcile.safety: Only objects carrying this integration's ownership marker are updated or removed. Foreign users and aliases fail closed.

success.testImapRealtime: The server advertises IDLE; real-time receiving is available.
success.testImapPolling: The server does not advertise IDLE; complete polling fallback will be used.
success.domainsAdded: Added {count} Mailu domains to the draft

deleteConfirm.title: Remove this domain?
deleteConfirm.description: Remove {domain} from this draft? Saving will disable its inbound and outbound configuration.
